findings.title: General during-Command Special Ability timing remains restricted
Human plans may Seize and Entreat repeatedly in the same Region
Devastate omits each human owner’s casualty choice
Rampage forces two Warbands instead of the actor’s chosen quantity
Scout cannot allocate one Auxilia across factions or choose Warband visibility
Seize only offers all-or-none dispersal for a Region
Intimidate removes a default Allied Tribe rather than a chosen Tribe
Build reorders all Regions by operation type
Human Battle casualty choices can violate mandatory loss priority tiers
Ordinary Battle casualties cannot select visibility or physical Allied Tribe
Retreat forces all Hidden defenders and Leader to stay and omits removal-only Retreat
Besiege uses automatic target priority instead of Roman choice
Rampage target cannot choose affected pieces or per-piece removal versus Retreat
Ordinary March cannot author transit dropoffs
March requires movement and cannot only hide at a selected origin
Several Event-granted Marches and German guidance still use automatic plans
Fixed Event Battle resolvers suppress human Region or defender selections
Gallic beneficiaries and command order are hardcoded; Remi Influence gives pieces to the wrong faction
Named factions never receive optional Event-effect decisions
Drought substitutes casualty priorities for every faction’s own selection
Event contracts cannot express smaller quantities or removal-only choices
Several direct Event removals cannot select physical visibility or exact Allied Tribe
Generated CLI Event schema cannot express several legal handler inputs
Human Capability activation/Region choices use unconditional NPC priorities
Gallic Shouts does not present its private two-card peek
Event plan validators accept selections outside printed quantity and target limits
German Allegiances cannot replace Warbands for a Gallic executor
Vosegus/Sabis choose human Battles and the optional second Battle with NPC policy
A19 shaded uses German NPC movement policy for human play and skips other executors
A67 omits the beneficiary and March choices and forces German human NPC Battle policy
A29 Raid and A69 Ambush targets are auto-derived for humans
A20/A58 Roman may-grants are forced or omitted depending on executor
A20/A58 Seize grants run forbidden enemy Rally rolls
A5 eviction forces the first Home Region and leaves non-Roman structures in Cisalpina
Three explicit up-to effects have no human quantity choice
Typed human Event plans bypass printed geographic, beneficiary and quantity limits
A22 shaded Capability never permits the added Intimidating Warband
A36 and other removal effects replace human physical-piece selections with fixed priorities
Remove-all expansion Events leave Scouted Warbands behind
Interlude force reductions and Cisalpina relocations bypass human owners
Roman Interlude expedition and marker-preservation choices are unreachable in human sessions
Pax first-Harvest Legion placement is automatically concentrated in one Region
Human Belgae starts The Great Revolt with the wrong Leader
Quarters cannot select which visibility cohort relocates
Resource-transfer choices are limited to one early outgoing CLI gift and omit legal Winter/incoming windows
Ariovistus accepts Resource transfers to the game-run Arverni
Three printed setup options have no selection or implementation
Shared player ownership is absent, so Spare Factions choices and consequences cannot be represented
Board inspection after SA-first Build shows the pre-SA board at the following March menu
Malformed Supply replacement escapes durable validation and changes the pending request under the same decision ID
